title: Recommendation
description: Recommendation produced by Person A's Consultant LLM step, consumed by Person B's Policy Gate

diagnosis.description: Root cause analysis of the dispute spike

precedents.description: Top-k similar past cases with matched_on and differs_on fields

case_id.description: Unique identifier of the precedent case

matched_on.description: Features the case shares with the current situation

differs_on.description: Features that differ from the current situation

intervention.description: Action taken in the precedent case

observed_outcome.description: Outcome metrics from the precedent case

effect.description: Observed effect (e.g., reduced dispute rate by 15%)

period.description: Time period over which outcome was measured

n_measured.description: Number of measured observational cases supporting this outcome

evidence_quality.description: Evidence quality level of the case

typed_action.description: Typed action from the fixed enum, validated by Person B's Policy Gate

playbook_notes.description: Qualitative notes explaining the recommended action and policy considerations

required_approval.description: Approval tier: AUTO (no approval needed), NEEDS_APPROVAL (one-click), BLOCKED (explicit human required)

abstain.description: Whether the system should abstain from recommending an action

abstain_reason.description: Reason for abstention if abstain is true
